long_biography.plain_text:
Before establishing The Knowledge Academy, Dilshad Hothi experimented with fish farming and garden-tool sales in India. He later moved to Britain and completed a marketing master's at the University of Lincoln. Several years in the training sector supplied the market knowledge that shaped his next venture.

Hothi launched the business in 2009, when the financial crisis increased demand for professional retraining. Early growth came from a broad customer base rather than dependence on one client, and an initially dismissive rival was acquired within two years. The group later widened its course portfolio and international reach through technology development and further acquisitions, while Hothi remained chief executive and a director of its holding company.
